hooks.name: Dart format and targeted analysis on save
hooks.description: After you save a Dart file: read-only format check (dart format --output=none), dart analyze on lib/domain, lib/content and lib/app files, and the focused test command to run after game-logic changes. After saving .gitignore: confirms build artifacts stay ignored and .kiro/ stays tracked. Never edits files, so it cannot re-trigger itself.
